description:
## Problem
Two methods in `src/vug/fetcher.cr` contain near-identical "parse URI, get hostname, resolve DNS into `initial_dns_ips` if not cached" logic:

- `prepare_request` (around lines 121–125)
- `handle_redirect_action` (around lines 187–193)

If the DNS caching policy changes (TTL, parallel resolution, error handling), it has to change in two places — a DRY violation and a reliability risk.

## Fix
Extract a private helper on `Fetcher` (or, if cleaner, on a small `DnsPrefetcher` collaborator) such as:

```crystal
private def prefetch_dns(url : String, cache : Hash(String, Array(String))) : URI?
  uri = parse_uri_safe(url)
  if host = uri.try(&.hostname)
    cache[host] ||= DnsCache.resolve(host)
  end
  uri
end
```

Then call it from both `prepare_request` and `handle_redirect_action`. Keep `handle_redirect_action` returning the new URI for the caller to assign.

## Why
- DRY: one place to evolve DNS strategy.
- Readability: both call sites become a single line.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Helper extracted and used in both `prepare_request` and `handle_redirect_action`.
- [ ] `ameba src/` reports 0 failures.
- [ ] `crystal spec` (full suite) still passes.
- [ ] Public API unchanged.
- [ ] `initial_dns_ips` caching semantics preserved (do not re-resolve a host already in the hash).

## Out of scope
- Do not change `DnsCache` itself.
- Do not move the `initial_dns_ips` map out of `LoopState`.
title: fetcher: extract shared DNS-pre-resolve helper
